description: Routes a tax, job-ending, renting, consumer or court question about Japan (JP), the United States (US; renting covers California and New York), France (FR), Spain (ES), mainland China (CN), the United Kingdom (UK; renting covers England), Taiwan (TW), Germany (DE) or Singapore (SG). Pass the question in the user's own language; returns the best-matching local OIYO tool (MCP tool name and tools.oiyo.net page in the local language), the free official help channel for that area, and for tax questions who may give paid tax advice in that country. Pass audience 'person' for someone's own job, home, purchase, claim, inheritance or residency, or 'pro' for running a business or advising one (filing calendars, penalties, appeals, depreciation, VAT, payroll cost, e-invoicing); every tool in the result is tagged with its audience. Routing and general information only: no legal or tax advice, no representation, no filing.

audience.description: Who is asking: person (own life) or pro (business or adviser); leave out for both

question.description: The question in the user's own words, any language
